summary: The sheet contains second-floor and basement alteration plans, general notes, keyed notes, and symbol legends. The plan references other indexed sheets for door schedules, wall assemblies, elevations, and details. Two sheet-local document/accessibility coordination items warrant clarification; no confirmed physical or life-safety discrepancy is established from this sheet alone.

drafts.title: First-issue revision date is incomplete
drafts.observation: The revision table identifies revision 00 as “FIRST ISSUE” but lists its date as “00,” which is not a complete date.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Revision table in the upper-right title-block area: “00 FIRST ISSUE 00”; subsequent entries show dates such as “10/29/25,” “12/16/25,” “02/16/26,” “07/17/26,” and “10/15/26.”
drafts.recommendation: Confirm the intended first-issue date and replace the “00” date entry with the project’s document-control date or applicable notation before permit issuance.

drafts.title: Accessibility standard edition cited in general notes should be verified
drafts.observation: The accessibility general notes cite “ICC/ANSI A117.1-2003” for reach-range requirements. The cited edition should be reconciled with the accessibility standard applicable to this permit set so that the note does not create an ambiguous or outdated design basis.
drafts.drawing_evidence: General Notes, Additional ADA Notes, item 4: “ADJUST ALL SELF SERVICE ITEMS TO BE WITHIN ACCESSIBILITY REACH RANGE REQUIREMENTS (ICC/ANSI A117.1-2003).” Other notes also refer to ADA-compliant signage, hardware, and opening force requirements.
drafts.drawing_location: Detail 3, GENERAL NOTES, Additional ADA Notes, item 4
drafts.recommendation: Have the design professional verify the applicable accessibility standard edition for the 2017 DC Construction Codes permit basis and revise the general note if necessary; confirm that the self-service reach-range design is documented using that verified basis.
